events.text: During this watch session for patient P1 (Routine), an alert for cutting without two clips was triggered at t=409 and automatically acknowledged for recording. Immediately following this, verification contradictions at t=411 indicated that the procedure was still in the dissection phase and the t=409 cutting observation was likely a false positive. Throughout the remainder of the session (t=441 to t=561), the system logged numerous verification contradictions regarding premature phase transitions to gallbladder dissection, impossible sequences of dissecting and clipping the cystic duct after it was marked as cut, and excessive clip counts due to multi-frame counting. Additionally, 15 frames were held back due to an obscured view or perception error. The simulation concluded in the gallbladder-dissection phase with 3/3 CVS achieved, no bleeding, the cystic duct marked as cut with 6 clips, and the cystic artery marked as clipped with 5 clips.
key_events: t=409: Alert 'cut_without_two_clips' triggered and automatically acknowledged for recording.
t=411: Verification contradictions noted that ongoing hook dissections indicated the t=409 cut was likely a false positive.
t=441-501: Multiple contradictions logged for the phase advancing to gallbladder-dissection while the cystic artery was neither clipped nor cut and pedicle dissection continued.
t=531-561: Contradictions identified an impossible sequence of clipping and dissecting the cystic duct after it was marked cut, alongside excessive clip counts (6 on duct, 5 on artery).
Session End: 15 frames held back due to obscured view or perception error; final state reached gallbladder-dissection with CVS 3/3 and no bleeding.
